svg.title: Which capabilities fit
svg.desc: The five capabilities of IBM Cloud Pak for Business Automation, as IBM names them: Workflow Automation, for complex workflows with AI-assisted design and execution; Decision intelligence, business policies turned into AI-powered decisions; Intelligent content services, enterprise content captured, managed and governed; Process Mining, a view of how processes actually run; Robotic Process Automation, software bots for repetitive, rule-based tasks.
